title: Bit torn off.
html_source: Stephen tore off a piece of Deasy’s letter to record a poem that was starting to come to him.

anchor.prefix:
resembles a railwayline? Reflect, ponder, excogitate, reply. 

1939#98

 Stephen handed over the typed sheets, pointing to the title and signature. 

 — Who? the editor asked.
anchor.suffix:
— Mr Garrett Deasy, Stephen said. 

 — That old pelters, the editor said. Who tore it? Was he short taken? 

On swift sail flaming 
From storm and south 
He comes, pale vampire
